title: Five-person LGBTQ+ student rights protest outside the Ministry of Education
reason: Contemporary sources report five participants in the public assembly, below the required threshold of at least 50.
notes: The gathering was outside MOE headquarters on Buona Vista Drive at about 5pm. CNA says the group called on Education Minister Lawrence Wong to end discrimination against LGBTQ+ students in schools. The police release says three remained after police arrived and were arrested around 5:35pm following warnings and a move-on direction. The later investigation and warning counts concern police action and are not turnout. News24, CNA and Lianhe Zaobao all report five, but some facts derive from SPF; the number of reports is not independent confirmation of every field. The opened Wikipedia page gives a conflicting 6 January/six-person description and cites later November warning coverage; that unresolved conflict is recorded in the associated gap and does not replace contemporary evidence. The event is excluded solely on the reported five-person turnout.
